name: The Oil Press
summary: A lever press worked by stone weights, racks of sealed amphorae, and a floor you will slip on.
description: Olives go in at one end of this room and oil goes out at the other in sealed amphorae stamped for the palace. Between the two stands the press: a cypress beam socketed into the wall, bearing down on baskets of crushed olives on a stone bed while two stones on a rope do the work of a man who would rather be elsewhere, and the oil runs from the bed's spout into a jar. Everything here is slippery, the racks are full, and one spark turns the whole room into a lamp.
build: Shell: the kit's OuterBailey shell, 12.0 × 12.0 × 0.30 m slab, 0.50 m ochre plaster walls 3.60 m clear, 0.45 m mud-brick capstone band, an archway 2.60 × 2.59 m centred on every wall.
Oil stain: a dark flat patch 3.00 × 2.40 m on the floor under the press, (−3.90, 4.20).
Press bed (NW): limestone 1.40 × 1.40 × 0.40 m at (−3.40, 4.20); two olive frails (woven baskets r 0.40 × 0.12 m) stacked on it at (−3.60, 4.30).
Press beam: cypress 3.48 × 0.20 × 0.20 m, socketed into the west wall at 2.00 m above ground and running east, falling to 1.55 m at its free end, x −2.00.
Pressing post: cypress 0.16 × 0.16 m from the frails up to the beam at (−3.60, 4.30).
Weights: a rope r 0.02 × 0.75 m from the beam's end to two stone discs r 0.30 × 0.25 m stacked on the floor at (−2.05, 4.20).
Collecting jar: 0.55 m tall, belly 0.50 m, at (−3.40, 3.10), a stone spout from the bed into it.

Amphora racks (NE, SE): against the north and south walls at x 3.60 (y ±5.10): two posts 0.75 m, a board 3.00 × 0.45 × 0.06 m on top at 1.05 m, a rail at 0.62 m; five amphorae 0.62 m tall under each board at x 2.40–4.60.
Jug table: cypress 0.60 × 0.60 m, 0.70 m high, at (−2.60, −3.40).
sockets: Archway ×4, centred on each wall: 2.60 × 2.59 m (OuterBailey), all open
Press beam socket: west wall, 2.00 m above ground

materials.name: Ochre plaster
materials.notes: Walls; oil-stained low behind the press.

materials.name: Terracotta
materials.notes: Amphorae, the collecting jar; frails are leather too.

materials.name: Olive oil stain
materials.notes: The floor patch under the press.

gameplay: Slippery: the oil patch under the press makes a running player slide (a hazard hook for later).
IGNIS on the oil pithoi or the racks lights the room.
The press beam and the racks are cover; the amphorae are loot but fragile.
